title: pilosella schultesii subsp. holubyana
intro: Pilosella schultesii subsp. holubyana, commonly known as a type of flowering plant in the dandelion family, is a subspecies of the Pilosella schultesii species. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including sesquiterpene lactones and flavonoids, which exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant activities. However, further research is needed to confirm the efficacy and safety of using Pilosella schultesii subsp. holubyana as a medicinal plant.
